official.label: Replit official pricing
official.scope: Current plan and included usage descriptions; regional tax, usage and exact account entitlements can vary.

official.label: Replit Agent official product page
official.scope: Official description of Replit Agent's app-building workflow; generated output still requires review.

official.label: Replit official AI billing documentation
official.scope: AI usage and billing boundaries; costs depend on plan, task and usage.

independent.label: TechRadar hands-on Replit review
independent.scope: Independent app-building workflow test examines prompt-to-app creation, code access, deployment and practical trade-offs; not a search-volume estimate.
independent.nonDuplication: TechRadar's tested task and editorial analysis are distinct from aggregated buyer reviews.

independent.label: Gartner Peer Insights Replit reviews
independent.scope: Verified enterprise-buyer reviews include both favorable and critical views of agent-generated apps, editing and deployment; review activity is a decision signal, not product truth.
independent.nonDuplication: Aggregated verified buyer feedback differs from TechRadar's hands-on app-build test and is not treated as an independent benchmark.

duplicateIntent.rationale: Read-only production name/title/official URL and collection-candidate checks for the selector's exact Replit scope returned no second entity. This refers to the Replit platform/Agent under its canonical product identity.

strongSignals: An independent hands-on app-build review and verified enterprise-buyer review activity provide distinct decision signals; neither measures aibesttool.com traffic.
supportingSignals: Replit publishes current first-party Agent, pricing and AI billing material.
marketValidation.limitation: Editorial readiness threshold only; no search-volume estimate or claim that generated applications are production-ready. Billing and generated results are task/account dependent.

brand.scope: Established browser-based development platform with current official Agent, plan and billing documentation; not a search-volume finding.

independentSignals.scope: Hands-on prompt-to-app review evaluates code access, deployment and application workflow.
independentSignals.nonDuplication: A tested workflow from a technology publisher, not aggregated rating data.

independentSignals.scope: Verified enterprise buyer feedback includes recent positive and critical Replit experience reports.
independentSignals.nonDuplication: Distinct verified-review dataset, not the TechRadar product test or a benchmark.

fastTrackEligibility.nonDuplication: Two different domains and evidence methods support a mature decision-intent brand signal, not measured search demand.

official.label: Otter official pricing
official.scope: Current plan allowances, import limits, transcription minutes, integrations and enterprise features; billing cadence and account eligibility matter.

official.label: Otter official feature documentation
official.scope: Official meeting transcription, Notetaker, AI chat, collaboration and workspace feature descriptions; plan availability varies.

official.label: Otter official privacy and security page
official.scope: Official privacy/security statements and participant-consent responsibilities; verify organizational and jurisdiction-specific requirements.

independent.label: Capterra verified Otter buyer reviews
independent.scope: Verified-user review activity and buyer feedback about Otter.ai; ratings and reviews are user reports, not a controlled transcription-accuracy test.
independent.nonDuplication: Independent review-platform feedback is distinct from Reuters' company/market reporting.

independent.label: Reuters Otter financing and company-scale report
independent.scope: Reuters reports the company's October 2026 financing, enterprise expansion plans and company-reported cumulative user milestone; this is a durability/scale signal, not independent product-quality verification.
independent.nonDuplication: Independent financial/business reporting, not the same evidence as Capterra user reviews; user count is attributed to the company.

duplicateIntent.rationale: Read-only production name/title/official URL and collection-candidate checks found no second Otter AI entity. Two existing shared Task Fit tool IDs were preserved in the duplicate snapshot; they are related alternatives, not duplicate entities.

strongSignals: Capterra hosts verified-user buyer feedback, while Reuters reports recent financing and company-reported scale; these are distinct review and business-durability signals, not a transcription benchmark.
supportingSignals: Otter publishes current plans, feature and privacy/security material.
marketValidation.limitation: Editorial readiness threshold only; the reported cumulative user count is company-reported, not independently audited. No search-volume or transcription-accuracy claim is made. Recording consent and plan-specific limits remain important.

brand.scope: Established meeting-assistant product with current official plans, feature help and privacy/security documentation; not a search-volume measurement.

independentSignals.scope: Verified buyer feedback informs a meeting-assistant purchase decision but does not establish transcript accuracy.
independentSignals.nonDuplication: Distinct verified user-review platform, not company-financing reporting.

independentSignals.scope: Recent independent business reporting covers enterprise expansion and company-reported cumulative user scale.
independentSignals.nonDuplication: Business durability/scale reporting differs from Capterra's verified buyer feedback; user figures remain company-attributed.

fastTrackEligibility.nonDuplication: Two distinct evidence types and domains support mature-brand decision interest, not independently audited adoption or measured search demand.
